description: This file implements the PruneEmptyCases function, which traverses an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to remove switch cases that are empty or followed only by other empty cases, effectively pruning unnecessary switch case blocks.

classes.name: PruneEmptyCasesTraverser
classes.description: A private class inheriting from TIntermTraverser that implements the logic to traverse and prune empty switch cases.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the pruning traversal on a given AST root.

methods.name: visitSwitch
methods.description: Overrides the visitSwitch method to analyze and potentially prune switch cases.
